title: spielmannia jasminum
intro: Spielmannia jasminum, commonly known as the "Indian Jasmine", is a plant species in the family Acanthaceae. It is native to the tropical regions of Asia and has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its numerous health benefits. The plant is known to have anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties, which provide therapeutic actions such as wound healing, fever reduction, and immune system support. Bioactive constituents present in Spielmannia jasminum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
